integration.notes: Fixed boundary; size is a radius, not a multiplier. Use an unscaled parent. Auto mode advances using update(dt) seconds, with speed fixed to 1. Manual mode advances fill only through setProgress(0..1); update still drives flow and the ending. Reaching 1 completes once; stop cancels without flashing. reset replays at the current transform. Changing warningDuration or progressMode restarts. finished means fully invisible, never an attack trigger. Flat or tilted planes only; no terrain fitting, collision, damage, external textures, particles, postprocessing or demo scheduling. See the bilingual integration guide.

Fixed rectangular boundary. length and width are full dimensions, not radii or multipliers. setOptions changes length, width and fillMode live without restarting or moving the center; switching fillMode preserves progress, including during the ending. Only warningDuration or progressMode changes restart. Auto uses update(dt) seconds; manual uses setProgress(0..1), with update driving flow and ending. Completion: 0.06s edge flash then 0.09s fade; cancel: 0.12s fade without flash. reset retains transform/settings. finished means fully invisible, never an attack trigger. Use an unscaled parent; flat or tilted planes only. No terrain fitting, collision, damage, external textures, particles, postprocessing or demo scheduling. User-approved simple-family exception to the 14-layer rule.

fillModes.forward: From -X to +X across the full width
fillModes.center-out: From Z=0 toward both Z edges across the full length
